title: Ribes NDE 919
content:
I was asleep, under anesthesia, then I was projected in a bright tunnel at a dizzying speed; some colors, some flashes of light. Then, a slowdown, I was out of the tunnel. I was floating in the air and I went forward; I heard divine music and a voice, which talked to me as if it were within myself. It was a soft and reassuring voice, which told me not to be afraid, and that I didn’t risk anything, which reassured me. At the same time, I was bathed in divine music; I didn’t feel anything, neither my heart beat, nor my body nor my body’s gravity. I was looking at my body: I didn’t have a body anymore. I got closer to a light that is more and more intense. Nevertheless, I didn’t have any pain in my eyes. I was able to distinguish three white silhouettes in the light, from the shoulders to the head. Being at just two or three meters (six and half to ten feet) away from them, I didn’t go forward any further. Those three beings were fascinating; a kindness emanated from them; I had no fear. Their large and black eyes, all black and globulous, almond-shaped eyes expressed compassion. The voice went on: it told me that it is not my turn and that I would start again. Then a great white light; I opened my eyes and the doctors succeeded in resuscitating me. My father told me, ‘you made us frightened’. Later on, I told my mother that I saw three angels.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Surgery-related Clinical death lors d'une opération d'une hernie inguinale, mort clinique, réanimation massage cardiaque, mon père était présent
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Void | Light | Strong emotional tone | Boundary | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes Without appearance, bathed in whiteness.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning I thought that it lasted ages, but my father told me that it lasted only a few seconds.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes A tunnel, like a whirl with a dizzying speed; some lights, some colors.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes Three beings bathed in whiteness with an oval shape. They spoke to me within myself, like my small inner-voice.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you reach a boundary or limiting phy: Yes I could not follow the beings of light anymore.
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Liberal A 7 ans, je n'avais pas de profil religieux particulier
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I was seven years old.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes The fear of not being understood.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I feel what people think; over-sensitivity and I feel very bad during or before a dramatic event relating to me.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The best part: the assurance that something else exists after death; the worst: a difficult experiment to assimilate and share; why me?
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes My mother didn't say anything to me but I know that she believed me.
